row.notes: Locked lookup in the hash-to-string table (g_Ne_StringTable): returns the registered string for an FNV-1a64 key hash, or null. Bag add-by-name 0x143932a40 registers every key it adds (0x14392a0c0), including every key the stream reader 0x143934620 reads from a save.

verify.notes: V1117 Proto const char*(void *table, uint64 hash) matches: hash==0 returns null without locking. Otherwise it takes the lock at table+8 (0x1449e2298/0x1449e22bc), probes the robin-hood map (mult table+0x20, buckets table+0x28, ctrl table+0x30, mask table+0x40) of 16-byte {u64 hash, char*} entries, and returns entry+8 on a hit or null at end. The 9 call sites and the one tail jmp (0x143a5b6e6) all load rcx=[0x146129740]. The map is filled by 0x14392a0c0 (lookup, then insert a heap copy of the string), called with FNV-1a64(name) from bag add-by-name 0x143932a40 and from the deserialiser 0x14364fe4e. So it returns the string registered for that hash in this process, or null.
